about: What a promotion gives (console v3 phase 7; decisions 0470 and 0472), in points, bonus chips, spins or a perk, never rupees. Days are the club's, 06:00 to 06:00 IST, and its weeks run Monday to Sunday. Eligible: the member's tier and audience must be the promotion's (new members have fewer than 30 whole days since joining; lapsed regulars' last visit before this one was 30 or more whole days before). The time-played rewards are the points multiplier, the play-time (hours) bonus and the free spin: for them only the minutes inside the schedule at its stakes and tables count, so the moment and table of the event do not matter. For every other reward the event's stake, table and moment must be the promotion's, so a promotion for some stakes gives nothing for an event away from a table. Grant: a buy-in bonus is a percent of the member's own chips rounded down to whole 50s, then held to its cap, or fixed chips; a buy-in paid from bonus (its own chips are 0) earns nothing from any buy-in reward, a buy-in bonus or bonus chips on the first buy-in; a points multiplier gives the extra on the points earned, rounded down (double on 120 is 120 more); a free spin needs its minutes; a play-time bonus pays each step as it is reached (owner, 8 Nov): its one step after a time, its set steps (two to six, rising), or one every so many minutes up to its times a visit and never past 24 hours, each step's chips once its minutes are played, nothing for a step it does not have, and nothing for time played at a visit's close; bonus chips come on a visit, the visit's first buy-in, a referral or a sign-up; a cab home from the Nth visit of the calendar month; an entry or waitlist priority on a visit; nothing comes to nothing. Limits, in this order: the member's period already given as often as it allows, once unless it says up to N (2 to 20) times (the same visit, club day, club week, ever, or with no limit the same event, and for a play-time bonus step that period @ the step's place among the promotion's steps, the first 1, so the limit holds for each step and a version that moves a step's minutes never pays it twice (the owner, 9 Nov), and with no limit a step's period is its visit; each grant in a period is keyed as the member's Nth there, the first by the period itself, then #2 and on), the first N buy-ins per table, which counts this promotion's grants at that table this club day, members a day (a member already given it today is not a new one), the most grants, and the budget in bonus chips, whole or not at all; a monthly budget and most grants count the grants of the event's calendar month of club days alone, starting again at 06:00 IST on the first. A spin spends no chips when given; the wheel pays a bonus only within what is left of the budget. Stacking for one event: at most one points multiplier, the one giving the most points (the first on a tie); bonus chips and spins from different promotions stack; one perk of each kind, the first given. Inputs are written as the database holds them.

cases.description: Everyone, every stake, Tuesdays: a buy-in at 21:00 on Tuesday qualifies.
Tuesdays: a buy-in at 21:00 on Wednesday does not.
Only 100/200: a buy-in at 50/100 does not qualify.
Only 100/200: a buy-in at 100/200 qualifies.
Only 100/200: an event away from a table has no stake, so it does not qualify.
Only Table 1: a buy-in at Table 2 does not qualify.
Only Founders' Circle: a Founders' Circle member qualifies.
Only Founders' Circle: a member with no tier does not.
New members, first 30 days: 29 whole days since joining qualifies.
New members, first 30 days: 30 whole days since joining does not.
Lapsed regulars: last here 30 days ago qualifies.
Lapsed regulars: last here 29 days ago does not.
Lapsed regulars: a member who never came before is not a lapsed regular.
Points multiplier, Friday 20:00 to 02:00 at 100/200: a visit closing at 03:00 on Saturday still qualifies; only its time inside the window at that stake earns.
Points multiplier for Founders' Circle only: a member with no tier does not qualify.
20% of a 10,000 buy-in: 2,000 bonus chips.
20% up to 1,000, on a 10,000 buy-in: the cap is smaller than 20%, so 1,000.
20% up to 2,000, on a 10,000 buy-in: exactly at the cap, 2,000.
20% up to 2,000, on a 5,000 buy-in: under the cap, 1,000.
10% of 2,499 is 249.9: rounded down to whole 50s, 200.
10% of 499 is 49.9: under one 50 chip, so nothing is given.
A buy-in paid from bonus chips earns no bonus.
Fixed 500 bonus chips on a buy-in: 500.
Fixed 500 bonus chips on a buy-in paid from bonus: nothing.
Double points on 120 earned: 120 more.
Triple points on 120 earned: 240 more.
1.25 times the points on 130 earned is 32.5 more: rounded down, 32.
Five times the points on 7 earned: 28 more.
Double points on nothing earned: nothing.
1,000 bonus chips after four hours, its one step: 3 hours 59 minutes is too short.
1,000 bonus chips after four hours, its one step: four hours exactly gives 1,000.
A play-time bonus weighs only its steps: time played at close gives it nothing.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: the four-hour step at 4 hours 10 minutes gives 1,000.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: the two-hour step gives 500.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: three hours is not one of its steps.
250 every 1.5 hours, twice a visit: the second step, at three hours, gives 250.
250 every 1.5 hours, twice a visit: a third step, at 4.5 hours, is past its cap.
50 every 12 hours: the 24-hour step a minute early is too short.
50 every 12 hours: the 24-hour step itself gives 50, the last of a day's play.
Two free spins after four hours: five hours gives two spins.
A free spin after four hours: three hours is too short.
1,000 bonus chips on each visit: a visit gives 1,000.
1,000 bonus chips for a referral: the referral gives 1,000.
500 bonus chips on sign-up: the sign-up gives 500.
1,000 bonus chips on the first buy-in: the visit's first buy-in gives 1,000.
1,000 bonus chips on the first buy-in: a second buy-in gives nothing.
1,000 bonus chips on the first buy-in: a first buy-in paid from bonus gives nothing.
Bonus chips on a referral are not given for a visit.
Bonus chips on a visit are not given for a sign-up.
A cab home from the fourth visit in a month: the third visit is not yet.
A cab home from the fourth visit in a month: the fourth visit gives it.
A tournament entry is given on a visit.
Waitlist priority is given on a visit.
A points multiplier is not given for a buy-in.
A buy-in bonus is not given for time played.
No limits and nothing given yet: given.
A budget of 5,000 with 4,000 given: a grant of 1,000 uses the last of it.
Budget exhausted mid-grant: 5,000 with 4,500 given cannot give 1,000, and never gives part of it.
A budget all spent still gives a spin, which spends no chips until it wins.
Once per member: a member who has had it does not have it again.
First 5 buy-ins per table: the fifth is given when four have been.
First 5 buy-ins per table: the sixth is not.
First 5 buy-ins per table: a buy-in away from a table cannot count among them.
50 members a day: a 51st member is not given it.
50 members a day: one of the 50 already given it today may have it again, as the per-member limit allows.
50 members a day: the 50th member is given it.
At most 100 grants: the 100th is given.
At most 100 grants: the 101st is not given.
Up to twice a day: a member given it once today has it again.
Up to twice a day: a member given it twice today has it no more.
Up to three times ever: the third is let through.
A monthly budget of 10,000 chips with 9,000 given this month: 1,000 more is let through, at the cap.
A monthly budget of 10,000 chips with 9,000 given this month: 1,050 more is not, never part of it.
At most 10 grants a month, 10 given this month: no more this month.
A monthly budget with nothing given this month: a zero-chip grant is let through.
Double and triple points on the same play: only the triple's 240 more points.
Double points all night (300 more) and triple points 20:00 to 22:00 (200 more): the one giving more, the double.
Two multipliers giving the same points: the first.
Bonus chips from two promotions stack.
A multiplier and an hours bonus on the same play: both, as only multipliers exclude each other.
Two cabs home for one visit: one cab.
Spins from two promotions stack.
Nothing to give: none.
A whole budget counts every grant, in every month.
A monthly budget counts the grants of the event's club month only: 05:59 IST on 1 December is still 30 November.
From 06:00 IST on 1 December a monthly budget starts again from nothing.
A member's grants in the period are counted with their numbered keys, not another member's or another day's.
Per club day: 02:00 IST is still the day before.
Per club week: Monday to Sunday, by the club day.
Per visit: the visit.
Per visit with no visit: the event.
Once ever.
No limit: the event itself.
Up to twice a day: the member's second grant today is numbered 2.
Up to 20 times ever: the twentieth is numbered 20.
1,000 after four hours: 3 hours 59 minutes reaches no step.
1,000 after four hours: four hours reaches its step.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: 1 hour 59 minutes reaches none.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: 4 hours 10 minutes reaches both.
250 every 1.5 hours, twice a visit: ten hours reaches two steps, its cap.
50 every 12 hours, no cap: a day's play reaches two steps, never past 24 hours.
50 every 12 hours, no cap: nothing played reaches nothing.
A play-time bonus step per visit: the visit and @ the step's place, the first.
A play-time bonus step per club day, its second time: the day, @ its place, #2.
A play-time bonus step with no limit: its visit, @ its place.
A play-time step: the period @ its place among the steps (the owner, 9 Nov).
A step a new version moved to other minutes is still the same step, so it is never paid twice.
A step with no limit: its visit, as a step is paid once a visit.
